cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openssl-1.1.1g; cat > /tmp/fuzz_asn1parse.py << 'EOF'
import subprocess
def gen_length(n):
    if n < 0x80:
        return bytes([n])
    b = n.to_bytes((n.bit_length()+7)//8, 'big')
    return bytes([0x80 | len(b)]) + b
cases = []
huge_len = 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
cases.append(bytes([0x30]) + bytes([0x88]) + huge_len.to_bytes(8,'big') + b'\x00')
cases.append(bytes([0x30]) + bytes([0x88]) + (0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF).to_bytes(8,'big') + b'\x00')
for n in [0x7F, 0x80, 0xFF, 0x100, 0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x100000000, 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF]:
    cases.append(bytes([0x30]) + gen_length(n) + b'\x00')
for n in [0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x100000000]:
    cases.append(bytes([0x24]) + gen_length(n) + b'\x00')
cases.append(bytes([0x30, 0x80, 0x00, 0x00]))
cases.append(bytes([0x24, 0x80, 0x04, 0x02]) + b'AA' + bytes([0x00, 0x00]))
for i, case in enumerate(cases):
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(['./fuzz/asn1parse-test'], input=case, capture_output=True, timeout=5)
        if r.returncode != 0:
            print(f"Case {i} CRASHED rc={r.returncode}: {case.hex()}")
        else:
            print(f"Case {i} ok")
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        print(f"Case {i} TIMEOUT")
EOF
